_comment: Vendor zero: SOFtruth's own reference implementation of the spec, deployed on
Railway. Disclosed as ours, not a third party. It exists so the record has a
real entry before any customer, and so vendors have a worked example to copy.
The bearer token is never committed. It comes from SOFTRUTH_TOKEN_REFERENCE in
the environment (a GitHub Actions secret in CI).
bounceWindowSeconds is 60 rather than the spec default of 600 because a probe
on 2026-09-07 held a message to a NXDOMAIN address for 625 seconds and Resend's
last_event never left 'sent'. Bounce notifications arrive by webhook and are not
surfaced on the retrieve endpoint, so this implementation cannot observe bounces
and no window length changes the answer.
